message:
fix(linux-sandbox): bind namespace reaper lifetime to command owner

Keep a pidfd for the original command owner across bubblewrap and cleanup forks. The trusted PID 1 reaper observes that stable identity with a blocking watcher, closes the handle in the payload, and fails closed on observation errors.

Add real pidfd and payload descriptor regressions. Keep the existing five-second disconnect regression unchanged and make six command-output fixtures use non-login shells. Formal native qualification remains pending.
